categories.main_business_segments: KENKO Mayonnaise Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: (1) Seasonings & Processed Foods (manufacturing and sales of mayonnaise, dressings, prepared salads, and processed egg products), (2) Delicatessen-related (manufacturing and sales of fresh salads and ready-to-eat foods for supermarkets and mass retailers, as well as contract production of processed foods and egg products), and (3) Other (mainly sales of prepared foods and delicatessen items, including shop operations).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary food processing technologies, including the development of long-life refrigerated salads, advanced mayonnaise and dressing formulations, and various egg processing techniques (such as thick omelets and scrambled eggs). Production emphasizes strict quality control, food safety certifications (FSSC22000, JFS-B, ISO17025), and traceability systems, with continuous R&D to improve product shelf life, health attributes, and operational efficiency for customers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KENKO Mayonnaise serves a diverse B2B customer base, including foodservice operators (restaurants, cafes), food manufacturers, bakeries, mass retailers, supermarkets, and convenience stores. Its products are widely used in the foodservice industry, retail prepared foods, and institutional catering, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in Japan, with manufacturing plants and sales offices nationwide. Overseas activities are limited but include a related company in Indonesia and past operations in China and Hong Kong. Over 90% of sales and assets are concentrated in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: KENKO Mayonnaise operates midstream and downstream in the food supply chain, sourcing raw materials (such as edible oils, eggs, and vegetables) and transforming them into finished and semi-finished food products for commercial and retail customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus, as outlined in its 'KENKO Vision 2035,' centers on strengthening its core business, accelerating global expansion, digital transformation (DX), and sustainability. R&D priorities include developing high-value-added, health-oriented, and environmentally friendly products, improving production efficiency, and supporting customer menu innovation. Human capital development and diversity are also emphasized.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured food products (mayonnaise, dressings, salads, egg products, and prepared foods) to business customers. Sales are recognized at the point of shipment, with most transactions settled within two months. There are no significant recurring or subscription-based revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KENKO Mayonnaise is a leading player in the Japanese commercial mayonnaise and prepared salad market, holding a top share in long-life salads. It faces competition from major food manufacturers (such as Kewpie and Ajinomoto) and numerous regional and specialized food processors. The company differentiates itself through product innovation and B2B solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥91.7 billion, with operating profit of ¥4.8 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥3.5 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth in sales and profitability, with a medium-term target of ¥125 billion in sales and ¥7.5 billion in operating profit by 2035. The workforce numbers approximately 1,000 employees (excluding temporary staff).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KENKO Mayonnaise emphasizes safety, reliability, and innovation in its food products, offering solutions that enhance customer operations (such as long shelf life, menu versatility, and operational efficiency). Its integrated value chain—from raw material procurement to product development, manufacturing, and quality control—enables rapid response to market needs and supports its vision to be the global leader in 'salad cuisine.'
